name: list-principal-reports
description: Items for the principal's digest since the last acknowledged digest, numbered 1..N. Include them in the digest. After the digest has been sent, call ack-principal-reports with the returned cursor. If the digest fails to send, do not ack: the items come back next time.

outputs.items: array ({ n, at, summary, urgency, link? }, oldest first)
outputs.cursor: string? (pass to ack-principal-reports after sending; null when empty)
outputs.hasMore: boolean (more items wait beyond this batch)
